Title: NETMESSAGE:They are here! Destroy the Archangels!
Translation: 他们来了！摧毁大天使们！

Title: NETMESSAGE:All the defenders of Godom perished. Thus ends the story of Godom.
Translation: 所有Godom的保卫者都牺牲了。因此Godom的故事结束了。

Title: NETMESSAGE:Hard difficulty selected. Weapons and longjump will respawn as normal.
Translation: 选择了困难难度。武器和长跳将正常重生。

Title: NETMESSAGE:Five minutes until the clouds above Godom rain fire.
Translation: 五分钟后，Godom上空的云层将降下火焰。

Title: NETMESSAGE:Three minutes until the clouds above Godom rain fire.
Translation: 三分钟后，Godom上空的云层将降下火焰。

Title: NETMESSAGE:One minute until the clouds above Godom rain fire.
Translation: 一分钟后，Godom上空的云层将降下火焰。

Title: NETMESSAGE:That day it rained fire upon the city. Thus ends the story of Godom.
Translation: 那一天，天降火雨于城市。Godom的故事就此终结。

Title: NETMESSAGE:The Rat of Returning has been sacrificed! A soul may return!
Translation: 归来之鼠已被献祭！一个灵魂可以回归！

Title: NETMESSAGE:The city is safe. Jahm is wounded. Godom shall prosper. Thus ends the story.
Translation: 城市安全了。Jahm受伤了。Godom将繁荣。故事就此结束。

Title: NETMESSAGE:A rain of fire will soon consume it.
NETMESSAGE:More are coming! Destroy the Archangels! Jahm will again need seven minutes to charge up his powers...
Translation: 更多敌人来了！摧毁大天使们！Jahm将再次需要七分钟来充能他的力量...

Title: NETMESSAGE:Once more! These must be the last... Destroy the Archangels! Jahm must once again recharge his powers!
Translation: 再一次！这必须是最后一次……摧毁大天使们！Jahm必须再次充能他的力量！

Title: NETMESSAGE:Hard difficulty selected. Respawn time for weapons and longjump increased.
Translation: 选择了困难难度。武器和长跳的重生时间增加。
